name: DIFC
description: DIFC is the leading financial hub for the Middle East, Africa, and South Asia. It is a unique financial free zone operating under an independent, English-language common law judiciary (DIFC Courts), separate from the wider UAE civil legal system.

taxSituation.corporateTax: 0% guaranteed for 50 years on qualified transactions (9% standard UAE corporate tax does not apply to qualified DIFC entities).
taxSituation.personalTax: 0% personal income tax on salaries and capital gains.
taxSituation.customsDuty: 0% customs duties within the free zone jurisdiction.
taxSituation.details: Companies benefit from 100% foreign ownership, full capital repatriation, and access to a massive network of double taxation treaties.

rules: Leash must be worn at all times in common walkways.
Pets are strictly restricted from the main high-density retail corridors of the Gate Avenue indoor promenade, though outdoor dining spots permit them.
Fines of up to 500 AED apply for not cleaning up after your pet.
petSituation.details: Primarily a commercial and high-end residential financial zone. Some residential buildings like Index Tower are pet-tolerant, but public grass areas are scarce compared to residential suburbs.

demographics.description: A cosmopolitan financial hub attracting high-net-worth professionals. Dominated by European and North American expats, alongside wealthy locals and high-earning Arab and Indian expats.

name: Downtown Dubai
description: Downtown Dubai incorporates world-recognized masterpieces including the iconic Burj Khalifa, the monumental Dubai Fountain, and the vast Dubai Mall. It serves as both an elite cosmopolitan community and a corporate center.

taxSituation.corporateTax: Standard UAE Corporate Tax of 9% applies strictly on net business profits exceeding 375,000 AED (~$102,000 USD).
taxSituation.personalTax: 0% personal income tax on individual salaries and investment portfolios.
taxSituation.customsDuty: 5% general customs duty applies on imported physical goods crossing physical borders.
taxSituation.details: Operating on the Mainland requires standard UAE Department of Economy and Tourism (DET) licensing, allowing you to freely trade inside any part of the UAE directly.

rules: Dogs must remain on strong, short leashes in all open public streets.

petSituation.details: Highly populated residential sidewalks and Burj Lake paths make walking your pet very beautiful, but you must keep them off public lawn zones of Emaar Burj Park.
